1241.text: The anointing with sacred chrism, perfumed oil consecrated by the bishop, signifies the gift of the Holy Spirit to the newly baptized, who has become a Christian, that is, one "anointed" by the Holy Spirit, incorporated into Christ who is anointed priest, prophet, and king.
1241.notes: scborromeo.org mirror; one vatican.va fetch makes it canonical. Part Two, The Sacrament of Baptism, 'How is the Sacrament of Baptism celebrated?' (the explanatory rites).
